text:
maria: Kickoff — security prelaunch checklist for the new eu-west4 GPU cluster. Need IAM roles, Vault mounts, KMS/HSM integration, and network egress policies validated before handoff.

leo: I'll own the IAM matrix and role ARNs. Planning least-privilege service accounts for runtime, autoscaler, and metrics.

aj: I'll track quota/cost implications (GPU quotas + cross-region egress). We might need an interim cap to avoid surprise spend. :money_with_wings:

sam: Quick note — Vault mount paths must be namespaced per-cluster, not shared. I'll add a PR to runbook.

maria: Agreed. Also, transit vs. kms for token encryption — prefer KMS-backed Vault seal with HSM root wrap when available.

sechub-bot: policy-scan started: scan-id=sc-2025-11-02-01. Targets: IAM, KMS key policies, Vault mounts.

hsm-team: HSM update: we provisioned a BYOK slot for eu-west4. Provisioning token 1-of-3 staged, requires rotation before prod.

leo: IAM quick checklist snippet:```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/redwood-eu4-serve"
}
```Only attach to the serving runtime SA. No '*' actions.

sam: I ran `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy redwood-eu4 --location=global` and confirmed roles are limited to the service account and security-admins. Pasted in the runbook.

aj: GPU quotas: eu-west4 default is 32 V100 equiv. Filed ticket Q-487 to request 200 for Dedicated trials. Until approved set autoscaler max to 80 to be safe.

maria: Network egress policy — block all outbound except to S3 endpoints, monitoring endpoints, and KMS. Use egress gateway + NAT with logging.

leo: Enforced SCPs: deny iam:PutRolePolicy and iam:CreatePolicy in org units for this cluster special OU. Adding example SCP in the PR.

sam: Vault check commands: `vault auth list` shows only approle and oidc for this namespace. Good. Also `vault policy read redwood-runner` shows no wildcard secrets.

hsm-team: HSM confirmation — key origin=HSM, attestation-present, firmware v2.1. Schedule key rotation window next Wednesday 0100-0200 UTC.

maria: Outstanding items before handoff: (1) Merge IAM matrix PR (leo), (2) Vault mount PR merged + test (sam), (3) KMS key policy attestation and HSM rotation schedule (hsm-team), (4) Quota increase ticket acknowledged (aj), (5) Network egress rule applied in staging and tested (infra).

leo: I'll post the role ARN list in the doc and tag security for a final review.

aj: I'll throttle autoscaler and add budget alert: cost center infra-eu4.

maria: Plan to do a 30-min handoff demo Mon 09:00 UTC. I'll create calendar invite and link runbook PR (#345). If anyone can't make it ping me.

sechub-bot: policy-scan complete: 3 findings (low): missing explicit kms:ReEncrypt in one role, egress logging disabled in one subnet. See report sc-2025-11-02-01.

sam: Taking on the egress logging fix now, will validate in staging and update the thread.

maria: Great — keep updates short here. Thanks all! :lock:
